purpose: Evidence contract for restoring UIPetInfoWnd portrait rendering.

selected_pe.encoding: legacy path literals are CP949 byte strings; shown paths decoded from those bytes.
selected_pe.address_mapping: For these literals selected PE preferred VA = image base 0x00400000 + file offset (e.g. byte_6F3990 at file offset 0x2F3990).

source_evidence.claim: GetPetIllustName(int job,int IsAccEquiped,char*) selects one of the table entries below. The IsAccEquiped parameter is not read in the decompiled function; accessory-equipped state does not change illustration filename.

Pet portrait block only runs for m_petJob != -1 and 1000 <= job < 1986. It loads Monster\%s.act/.spr using the job-name table, selects action=0,motion=0, tries the illust bitmap first; if CResMgr::IsExist succeeds and Get returns non-null it draws at (5,21). Otherwise renders motion clips in the portrait viewport.

source_evidence.source: HighPriest.exe bytes at listed offsets; Ref/Session2.cpp byte_724xxx references
source_evidence.claim: BMP literal filenames and path encoding provenance. String references have VA = file offset + 0x400000.
The selected PE contains CP949 literals 몬스터\%s.act at 0x2F3980 (VA 0x6F3980) and 몬스터\%s.spr at 0x2F3990 (VA 0x6F3990).

fallback_mapping.condition: Every job in the UI range not explicitly listed maps to the default illustration. Explicit IDs 1063 and 1879 map to 펫_루나틱.bmp.

portrait_layout.first_clip_base: first clip (index 0) is centered at x=(90-spriteWidth)/2 and y=(134-spriteHeight)/2. alignx=-firstClip.x, aligny=-firstClip.y. srcx=(90-spriteWidth)/2, srcy=(134-spriteHeight)/2.
portrait_layout.later_clip_origin: x=clip.x+alignx+srcx; y=clip.y+aligny+srcy. Each clip is clipped to [0,90)x[0,155), then rendered at global (5+x,21+y). Clip order is preserved.
portrait_layout.clip_crop: At left/top underflow destination coordinate is clamped to 0; width/height are reduced when right/bottom exceed viewport. The original call passes Clip.flags, isHalfW+1 and isHalfH+1 as sprite rendering parameters.

resource_formats.spr: src/res/Sprite.cpp LoadFromBuffer: little-endian header {u16 id=20563 (0x5053),u16 version<=0x0201,u16 indexedCount}; version >=0x0200 adds u16 rgbaCount; version >=0x0101 stores 1024-byte palette at file tail. Indexed images are {u16 width,u16 height,pixels}; version >=0x0201 uses u16 compressedSize then zero-run stream. RGBA image rows are read bottom-up as RGBA bytes. Indexed sprite index 0 transparent; palette colors used for clipType 0.
resource_formats.act: src/world/GameActor.cpp CActRes::LoadFromBuffer and Ref/dhxj/Resource/Action.cpp: header {u16 id=17217 (0x4341),u16 version,u16 actions,u8 reserved[10]}; then action motion counts, each motion has two RECTs, sprite count and clip records. Version <0x0200 clips are {int x,y,sprIndex,flags}; >=0x0200 add RGBA, zoom and angle and clipType; >=0x0204 uses separate zoomX/Y; >=0x0205 adds logical width,height per clip; events/attachment points/delays are version-gated. ACT v>=0x0200 x/y are sprite centers converted to top-left by ReCalcClipXY; logical size doubles half-width/half-height images.

available_render_helpers.sprite_decode: CSprRes::LoadFromBuffer decodes indexed and RGBA SPR banks; GetSprite(clipType,index); palette m_pal[256].
available_render_helpers.act_decode: CActRes::LoadFromBuffer parses action/motion clips and applies ReCalcClipXY from sprite dimensions or ACT v0x205 logical dimensions.
available_render_helpers.compositor: src/render/DC.cpp BlitMotionToArgb/DrawActMotionToArgb render motion layers to ARGB, with alpha, palette, color modulation and horizontal flip; DrawActMotionToHdc blends a motion to an HDC using bounding box. shopui::DrawBitmapPixelsTransparent uses AlphaBlendArgbToHdc and should handle BMP illustration pixels.

fidelity_notes: Use a decoded CBitmapRes/GameData bitmap and draw at the literal origin, no scaling, only if both IsExist and Get succeed; otherwise use the action0/motion0 SPR/ACT composition.

BlitMotionToArgb is a useful decoder/compositor foundation but its normal positioning uses already converted clip top-lefts at a caller-supplied base and computes whole-motion bounds; portrait needs special first-clip anchoring and explicit 90x155 clipping.

Current BlitMotionToArgb only applies flags bit 0 horizontal flip, palette/RGBA alpha and clip color modulation. It does not apply clip zoom, rotation, full renderer flip/crop flags, or emulate the original isHalfW/isHalfH texture args. For exact legacy fallback rendering, preserve the UIFrameWnd coordinate equations/clip order and apply sprite texture sampling crop consistently; assess whether pet assets rely on zoom/rotation/half-size flags.
Reference renderer clamps x/y to viewport and shrinks width/height but passes no explicit source offset change for negative origin; crop details depend on legacy sprite renderer flags/UV behavior.
